Agent's extractor picked an unrelated number via majority-voting across OCR variants on a cleanly readable receipt."},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","observed":"23.26","issue":"Receipt actually shows 'TOTAL: 23.25' after rounding adj; agent read the pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' instead of the final rounded TOTAL line."},{"filename":"034.jpg","field":"date","observed":"2018-08-09","issue":"Date on receipt is 09/03/2018 (DD/MM/YYYY → 2018-03-09). Agent swapped month/day, likely because date parsing tried an alternate format or ambiguous 2-digit swap."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc1","summary":"Multi-variant OCR + voting can elect a wrong candidate on clean receipts","detail":"Majority voting across OCR variants (including heavily preprocessed/mangled ones) can outvote the correct reading. On 074.jpg, two variants produce the same spurious number and win over the correct 538.00. Voting lacks a priority weighting for stronger keyword tiers (GRAND TOTAL) and for cleaner variants.","skills_implicated":["image-ocr"]},{"id":"rc2","summary":"Keyword-tier scanning does not prefer the final rounded TOTAL line when multiple TOTAL-labeled lines coexist","detail":"On 077.jpg the receipt has 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26', 'Rounding Adj: -0.01', 'TOTAL: 23.25'. The extractor returned 23.26 because its priority tier matched the earlier 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' line and did not re-check for a later, more-specific standalone 'TOTAL:' line following a 'Rounding Adj' line.","skills_implicated":["image-ocr"]},{"id":"rc3","summary":"Fallback-to-next-line logic over-triggers on column-header lines and corrupted keyword lines","detail":"Agent's own traces show line 'Description Qty Price Amount' triggered AMOUNT keyword and fell through to the first item row (20.00) for 078.jpg. The partial fix adds DESCRIPTION/QTY|PRICE AMOUNT exclusions but is narrow; similar header patterns (ITEM/DESC/PRICE/AMT/TOTAL variants) are not covered.","skills_implicated":["image-ocr"]},{"id":"rc4","summary":"Regex for GRAND TOTAL requires whitespace and misses OCR glue/typos","detail":"Patterns like `\\bGRAND\\s+TOTAL\\b` fail on OCR outputs 'GrandTotal', 'GrandTota.', 'Grand Tota.', 'Grand Total ——'. Highest-priority tier therefore silently drops, demoting matches to generic TOTAL (worse candidates) or to None.","skills_implicated":["image-ocr"]},{"id":"rc5","summary":"Preprocessing variants are too few for small/low-contrast receipts","detail":"078.jpg only becomes readable at 3× upscale + PSM 4. Default variants (default, gray+psm6, 2× gray+psm6) miss it. Skill text mentions multi-pass OCR but does not prescribe a strong-enough preprocessing ladder (e.g., 3× upscaling, binarization/thresholding, PSM 4 for columnar receipts) as the default for receipts.","skills_implicated":["image-ocr"]},{"id":"rc6","summary":"Date extraction accepts an ambiguous DD/MM vs MM/DD swap without disambiguation heuristic","detail":"For 034.jpg (09/03/2018), extractor returned 2018-08-09, implying MM/DD was tried and succeeded (08 month, 09 day) with a different OCR reading, or regex order allowed MM-DD-YYYY to match before DD-MM-YYYY. Receipts in this dataset are consistently DD/MM/YYYY; the skill should pin region/format or use anchoring cues (slash separators + value>12 in first field) before falling back.","skills_implicated":["image-ocr"]},{"id":"rc7","summary":"Agent terminated at max_iterations with incomplete fix cycle","detail":"Timeline shows termination_reason=max_iterations after mid-fix (added 3× upscale variant but never re-ran). Skill lacks guidance to budget iterations and finalize/re-run after each extractor change before the loop ends.","skills_implicated":["image-ocr","xlsx"]}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Priority-tier scan takes first match within tier; does not look for a stronger candidate (e.g., a standalone 'TOTAL: xx.xx' line that appears AFTER a 'Rounding Adj' line) within the same priority tier."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"GRAND TOTAL / TOTAL regex family does not tolerate missing/collapsed whitespace, trailing punctuation, decorative characters (—, =, dots) adjacent to the keyword, or truncated 'Tota.' spellings."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Column-header exclusion is incomplete. Receipts commonly expose 'Qty Description Amount (RM)', 'Item U/P Amount', 'Description Price Total', 'QTY ITEM TOTAL'; only DESCRIPTION / (QTY|PRICE) AMOUNT are excluded."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Fallback 'take last number on next non-empty line' can grab a line-item amount when the matched line was actually a header; needs confirmation that the matched line is in the receipt's summary region (below item table) before falling back."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Multi-pass OCR ladder is too short: only default / gray+psm6 / 2× gray+psm6 are used. Receipts with faint ink or small print need 3× upscaling, binary thresholding, and PSM 4 as additional default passes."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Variant voting treats all variants equally and can be outvoted by two mangled variants producing the same spurious number; no tie-break by keyword-tier strength or by candidate line's distance to the 'summary start' anchor."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date parsing lacks a documented preferred locale/format for ambiguous DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY and does not use context cues (day/month > 12, nearby weekday names) to disambiguate."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Null-handling guidance is correct in isolation but does not stress: if OCR confidence is low across all variants AND no priority-tier keyword matched cleanly, prefer null over a low-confidence number — reducing false positives like 702.00."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No explicit guidance to re-run the end-to-end pipeline after each extractor change and before finishing, and to always materialize final Excel atomically; combined with iteration limits this contributes to incomplete runs."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand GRAND TOTAL / TOTAL keyword patterns to tolerate collapsed whitespace and trailing punctuation: match patterns equivalent to `GRAND\\s*TOTA[L.]?`, `NETT?\\s*TOTA[L.]?`, `TOTAL\\s*[:\\-]?\\s*RM?`, and allow the TOTAL token to be followed by any mix of `=`, `—`, `–`, `.`, `:` before the number. Keep the exclusion list applied first.","generality":"Benefits all receipts with imperfect OCR of the keyword."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Within each priority tier, do not short-circuit on first match. Collect all candidate lines in the tier, score them by: (a) proximity to the receipt summary region (lines after the item table / after a 'Subtotal' or 'Rounding Adj' line get +weight), (b) presence of a well-formed 2-decimal number on the same line, (c) absence of per-item columns (Qty/Price present on the same line reduces weight). Return the highest-scoring candidate; only then move to the next tier.","generality":"Fixes 077-type cases where multiple TOTAL-labeled lines coexist and the correct one is the final rounded TOTAL."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Broaden column-header exclusion. Treat as a header any line that contains ≥2 of {DESCRIPTION, ITEM, QTY, QUANTITY, U/P, UNIT PRICE, PRICE, AMOUNT, TOTAL, RM, CODE, TAX} AND no 2-decimal number on the same line. Document this heuristic explicitly.","generality":"Prevents fallback from grabbing first item-row amount."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Gate the two-line fallback. Only fall through to the next non-empty line's last number if (i) matched line is not a column header per the heuristic above, (ii) matched line is in the summary region (below the detected item table), and (iii) the next line has exactly one 2-decimal number (not three columns of numbers).","generality":"Reduces false positives from fallback across all receipts."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Strengthen the default OCR variant ladder for receipts: (1) default, (2) grayscale+autocontrast PSM 6, (3) 2× upscale grayscale+autocontrast PSM 6, (4) 3× upscale grayscale+autocontrast PSM 4, (5) binarized (Otsu-like threshold ~128) PSM 6. Prefer PSM 4 for narrow single-column receipts and PSM 6 for wider ones; include PSM 11 only as a last resort.","generality":"Covers faint/small/low-contrast receipts; demonstrated to recover 078-type cases at 3× PSM 4."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Replace equal-vote voting with weighted candidate selection across variants: each candidate carries (priority_tier, keyword_strength, numeric_well_formed, summary_region_bonus). Choose the candidate maximizing the tuple; use variant count only as a secondary tie-break. Document that a single clean match from a stronger keyword tier beats multiple matches from a weaker tier.","generality":"Fixes 074-type majority-voting failures and generalizes to any receipt with noisy variants."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a confidence floor: if the final chosen candidate did not match any tier-1/tier-2/tier-3 keyword (only generic TOTAL/AMOUNT), and the OCR line it came from has fewer than N alphabetic characters near the number, return None instead of a guessed value. Document this as 'prefer null over low-confidence'.","generality":"Reduces catastrophic wrong-value errors across the dataset."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Specify date-parsing policy for receipts: default to DD/MM/YYYY and DD-MM-YYYY ordering before MM/DD/YYYY. Add disambiguation rule: if the first group >12 and second ≤12, it is DD/MM; if first ≤12 and second >12, it is MM/DD; otherwise, use the receipt-locale default (DD/MM for this dataset family). Validate year ∈ [1990, current_year+1]. Explicitly reject matches that produce a date >today or <1990.","generality":"Fixes 034-type month/day swaps and other ambiguous dates."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'summary region anchor' helper documented in the skill: scan from the bottom up for the first occurrence of SUBTOTAL/ROUNDING/TOTAL/CASH/CHANGE; mark that line index as 'summary_start'. Candidates for total_amount must be at or after summary_start when such an anchor exists; otherwise, fall back to full-document scanning.","generality":"Improves precision across all receipts with clear summary blocks."},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Update the Quality Self-Check and Critical Rules sections to explicitly list: priority-tier ordering, exclusion-first, OCR-robust GRAND TOTAL variants, prefer-later TOTAL after Rounding Adj, column-header heuristic, gated two-line fallback, and prefer-null-on-low-confidence.","generality":"Hardens the skill's documented contract so future runs internalize these rules."},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a brief note in the Common Workflow for 'batch extraction to Excel' tasks: always run the full pipeline end-to-end, write the final xlsx atomically (tmp → rename), and verify row count equals input image count before finishing. Encourage checkpointing partial results so iteration-limit terminations still yield a valid file.","generality":"Prevents data-loss on long runs across any batch extraction task."}],"confidence":"medium"}
